card.name: Small linking words before liver or kidney terms
card.fires_on: Commas, 'by', 'or' and 'the' that come right before an organ or symptom term in liver and kidney warnings. Also a blank gap after a section reference like 'Adverse Reactions ('.

modes.label: Gap in section cross-reference
modes.description: A blank token inside a bracketed reference to Adverse Reactions, before the section number.
